description:
Exhilarating performance
Dressed to impress and packing a serious performance punch, Karve EVO RS is our most affordable, unstoppable, maximum control gravity thrill machine for self-shuttled riding, bike park play, and big mountain terrain. Engineered with the confidence, capability and control to enable you to master the toughest tracks, its powerful assistance makes climbing efficient so you can shuttle quickly, backed up with the range to drop-in again – and again. Combining proportional geometry with size-specific tuning Karve EVO RS delivers perfectly balanced handling for every rider to keep you in control when it counts most. Whether you’re sessioning the bike park, getting your kicks on the roughest, most technical descents, or all-mountain riding, Karve EVO RS is built to perform year-round. All to give you the confidence to take on more. If the biggest terrain is your playground, Karve EVO RS is your access all areas pass.

Highlights
– 180mm front and rear of proven Quad-Link 4 suspension, with carefully custom-tuned rear shocks.
– Uni-directional carbon fibre (front) and alloy (rear) frame with geometry adjustment is light and strong.
– Avinox M2S full-torque (up to 150Nm), full-power (1300W peak) motor with five assistance modes (auto, eco, trail, turbo + boost).
– SRAM Eagle 70 mechanical T-Type 1x12 transmission + SRAM Maven Base four-piston hydraulic brakes.
– Avinox DPC100 OLED top-tube touchscreen display delivers a wealth of customisable information at your fingertips.
– 800Wh internal battery so you can get more runs in.
– MX wheels (29er front, 27.5in rear) for maximum confidence on even the steepest terrain + full 29er ready.

Ideal for... Gravity thrill seekers, self-shuttlers, bike-park and big mountain riders looking for the very best descending + self-shuttle performance – without a peak price tag.

Charge time (800Wh): 80% in 4hr 54mins approx. from empty, and to 100% in 6hrs 11mins approx. with 4A charger.

Discover Karve EVO >
